# Unit Converter Ai MCP

> Unit Converter MCP — automation tooling for unit converter

`unit-converter-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install unit-converter-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx unit-converter-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `convert_length` — Convert between length units: mm, cm, m, km, inch, foot, yard, mile, nautical_mile, light_year.
- `convert_weight` — Convert between weight units: mg, g, kg, tonne, oz, lb, stone, ton_us, ton_uk.
- `convert_temperature` — Convert between temperature units: celsius, fahrenheit, kelvin, rankine.
- `convert_currency_data` — Convert currency using static reference rates (for estimation only). Use live API for production.
